quick_read: **Token payoff** : Okoye makes two 1/1 Soldiers on entry and gives attacking tokens first strike, so the deck wants a wide, pumped token army.
**Two plans** : The deck builds either a go-wide Tokens shell or a Blink shell that re-enters Okoye to make Soldiers repeatedly.
**Low-data commander** : With only about 10 decks on EDHREC, these synergies are judged from the card's own oracle text rather than a large meta.
**No combos** : Okoye has no Commander Spellbook combos, so both plans win through creature swarm and value rather than loops.
combos_note: Okoye has no known Commander Spellbook combos — she is a low-data commander just breaking into the format, so his primer flags that honestly. Both of Okoye's plans win the fair way: the Tokens plan runs away with a wide, first-striking Soldier army backed by doublers and anthems, while the Blink plan re-enters Okoye (and other enters-the-battlefield creatures) to re-create tokens and grind out value. There are no infinite loops to assemble — the win comes from board presence and repeated triggers, not from a two-card kill.
